Whether you have already started your IT support career or gained practical experience through an internship or education, this could be your next step. As an End User Support Specialist, you will provide hands-on IT support to colleagues onsite. You will handle issues that the Service Desk cannot resolve remotely, troubleshoot equipment and help keep daily operations running smoothly. To be considered, you must already live in the Netherlands and have the legal right to work here, including a valid work permit if required. This role requires you to work onsite five days a week in Alphen aan den Rijn, with travel to other company locations when needed. Remote working is not available. Please apply only if you meet these requirements. What will you do? You will be the person colleagues turn to when they need practical, onsite IT support. Your responsibilities include: Troubleshooting hardware, software and network issues escalated by the Service Desk. Supporting PCs, laptops, printers, telephony and CCTV equipment. Installing, configuring and maintaining computers, peripherals and software. Helping users with accounts, access permissions and system performance. Preparing and setting up equipment for new users and system deployments. Working with the Service Desk and other IT teams to resolve recurring problems. Recording issues and solutions in the ticketing system. Keeping IT inventory accurate and equipment well maintained. What do you bring? You enjoy helping people, approach problems logically and explain technical solutions clearly. You take ownership of your work and know when to involve a colleague. We are looking for: A practical foundation in IT support, gained through work, an internship, education or other relevant hands-on experience. Basic experience troubleshooting, installing or configuring computers and software. A service-minded attitude and a willingness to develop your technical skills. The ability to prioritise tasks and stay organised. Good spoken and written English. Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-moving startup environment. You do not need years of experience to apply. If you have a solid technical foundation and are motivated to learn, we would like to hear from you. More experienced IT support professionals are equally welcome. An IT qualification or certification, such as ITIL, is a plus. Relevant practical experience also counts. What can you expect? A salary of up to €5,000 per month , depending on your knowledge and experience. A full-time role with varied, hands-on technical responsibilities. Direct contact with the colleagues you support. Opportunities to build your technical knowledge through practical experience. A recruitment process consisting of two interviews via Microsoft Teams . Location and working hours Primary location: Alphen aan den Rijn, Netherlands. Work arrangement: Five days per week onsite. Working hours: 09:00–18:00. Travel: You may need to support other company locations when required. Flexibility: Occasional support outside regular working hours may be required for urgent issues. Interested? Send your CV and briefly tell us why this role suits you. You do not need to meet every technical preference, but you must already live in the Netherlands, be legally authorised to work here and be available to work onsite five days a week .

Build portfolio roadmaps using the ‘Ice, Water, Steam’ framework (the current quarter is locked, the next quarter is fluid and future quarters are conceptual). Manage budgets for time-bound projects, vendor SLAs and risk registers. Line-manage and coach Project Managers, who lead finite initiatives, and Delivery Leads and Scrum Masters, who facilitate Squad ceremonies from outside the Squad. Encourage a culture of servant leadership throughout. Assess risks across the portfolio and keep clear escalation routes open, so the C-Suite can step in when dependencies put revenue targets or delivery timelines at risk. Experience: 7- 10 years of project management experience, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership or PMO management role. A proven track record of working in a hybrid operating model, managing finite, time-bound projects alongside long-lived Agile Value Streams and Squads. Experience managing project budgets, resources, and external vendors or partners. Hands-on experience integrating change management into transformation initiatives. Demonstrated experience reporting directly to C-Suite/Board executives on portfolio health, capital trade-offs, and risk mitigations. Technical Skills: Expert command of hybrid delivery management, applying Waterfall and PMP methods to physical facility builds, and outcome-driven frameworks such as OKRs, Scrum and Kanban to digital and operational streams. Expertise in project planning, resource allocation, budgeting, and risk management. Confident use of enterprise portfolio tools such as MS Planner, Jira Align and Power BI, with experience designing PMO governance frameworks. Ability to design and maintain PMO governance frameworks, standards, templates, and reporting dashboards. Leadership and Soft Skills: Strong leadership skills, with the ability to direct, coach, and motivate teams in a collaborative, high-performance culture. Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the credibility to engage senior executives and sponsors. Strategic thinking, strong problem-solving, and sound decision-making under pressure. Stakeholder management and relationship-building skills across internal and external parties. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify and implement process enhancements. The ability to work comfortably within a matrix organisation, balancing the needs of the C-Suite with the autonomy of the Squads. Language: Fluent in English and Arabic, written and spoken (adjust to your needs).

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: About the Company Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform that helps businesses accept payments, grow revenue, and expand their operations. From global enterprises to emerging startups, millions of companies use Stripe's technology to manage payments and support online commerce. Its mission is to increase the GDP of the internet by making economic opportunities more accessible. About the Team The High Availability and Disaster Recovery team is responsible for building systems that keep Stripe's products reliable and resilient during disruptions. The team designs solutions that help latency-sensitive, stateful applications withstand a wide range of failures while protecting customer data. Working with distributed systems across data centers and regions, the team develops new approaches to availability, redundancy, disaster detection, and automated failover. Its work will help shape Stripe's long-term technical architecture. The team includes remote engineers and works collaboratively across the company. About the Role Stripe is seeking an experienced software engineer to help design and develop highly available, resilient distributed systems. You will work on critical infrastructure where latency, data redundancy, reliability, and recovery from failures are essential. The work spans system architecture, service development, disaster recovery, and automation, with opportunities to solve complex problems across multiple regions and services. This role requires substantial experience in distributed and cloud-native software development, along with the ability to lead large engineering initiatives and influence technical decisions across teams. You will also mentor engineers, contribute to engineering strategy, and help establish the standards and practices that support Stripe's long-term reliability goals. Key Responsibilities Work with engineering leaders and teams across Stripe to identify opportunities to improve system reliability. Scope, design, implement, and deploy robust distributed services for highly available and resilient infrastructure. Balance reliability, throughput, latency, resilience, engineering velocity, and cost when making architectural decisions. Develop solutions that improve service availability and protect data across regions and data centers. Design and implement new products, prototypes, and tools that strengthen service resilience and support engineering at scale. Contribute to disaster detection and automated failover capabilities. Help shape engineering strategy, tooling, processes, and technical culture. Mentor engineers and support the development of future technical leaders. Maintain high engineering standards and improve existing codebases and development practices. Required Qualifications At least 10 years of experience in distributed and cloud-native software development at a highly scaled service provider or hyperscaler. Deep understanding of scalable and resilient distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and mission-critical systems. Experience influencing, planning, scoping, and leading large engineering projects across multiple teams. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders and subject matter experts. Ability to work autonomously, take responsibility, and proactively identify and address technical challenges. A strong track record of technical leadership and mentoring across several engineering teams. Location and Work Arrangement This is a distributed role with remote work opportunities. Candidates must be able to work from within the United States or Canada. Additional Information Stripe encourages candidates who meet the minimum qualifications to apply. Preferred qualifications are not listed as mandatory requirements.

review_candidates.title: Backend Developer
review_candidates.description: About The Company Nexus Jobs is a leading global recruitment firm dedicated to connecting talented professionals with top-tier organizations across various industries. With a strong emphasis on integrity, innovation, and excellence, Nexus Jobs has built a reputation for delivering exceptional staffing solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of each client. Our team of experienced recruiters leverages extensive industry knowledge and a vast network to identify the best candidates, ensuring a perfect fit for both employers and job seekers. Committed to fostering long-term relationships, Nexus Jobs continuously strives to create value and contribute to the success of the organizations and individuals we serve. About The Role We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented professional to join our team in the role of Recruitment Specialist. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process, from sourcing and screening candidates to facilitating interviews and extending offers. This role requires excellent communication skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to build strong relationships with both clients and candidates. The Recruitment Specialist will play a vital role in ensuring that Nexus Jobs maintains its reputation for delivering high-quality staffing solutions and will work closely with various departments to understand their hiring needs and develop effective recruitment strategies. Qualifications The ideal candidate should possess a bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Prior experience in recruitment or talent acquisition is highly desirable, with a proven track record of successfully filling roles across different industries. Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential, along with the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools will be advantageous. The candidate must demonstrate excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment. Responsibilities Manage the full recruitment cycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates to meet client requirements. Develop and implement effective sourcing strategies to attract a diverse pool of qualified candidates through various channels such as job boards, social media, and networking events. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to understand their staffing needs and provide tailored recruitment solutions. Conduct thorough interviews and assessments to evaluate candidates' skills, experience, and cultural fit. Coordinate with clients and candidates to schedule interviews, provide feedback, and facilitate the offer process. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all recruitment activities in the applicant tracking system. Stay informed about industry trends and best practices in recruitment to continuously improve sourcing and hiring strategies. Assist in employer branding initiatives to enhance the company's presence in the talent market. Participate in career fairs, networking events, and other outreach activities to expand the candidate network. Provide a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process, ensuring professionalism and transparency at all times. Benefits Nexus Jobs offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ well-being and professional growth. Our benefits include competitive salary packages, health insurance coverage, and paid time off. We also provide opportunities for continuous learning and development through training programs, workshops, and industry conferences. Employees enjoy a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages innovation and career advancement. Additionally, we promote work-life balance through flexible working arrangements and employee wellness initiatives. Joining Nexus Jobs means becoming part of a dynamic team committed to excellence and making a meaningful impact in the staffing industry. Equal Opportunity Nexus Jobs is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other protected characteristic. Our hiring practices are based solely on merit, qualifications, and the ability to contribute to our organization’s success. We believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and drives better business outcomes, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals.
